beats.narration_text: Every pipeline has the same shape: source, destination, and a mountain of glue in between. Rename this column. Cast that timestamp. Guard the null the vendor swears never happens. Extract and load are easy — the transform in the middle is where the weeks go.

beats.narration_text: Twelve columns line up. Three do not. Created-at is a string going into a timestamp. Amount is a float going into a decimal — a rounding bug waiting for month-end. Customer-id is nullable on one side, not-null on the other. Claude found all three; it decided none of them.

beats.role_note: ACTUAL-CODE LAW - the real generated transform, trimmed to the lines that teach
beats.narration_text: And this is what it wrote. One rule per flag. Parse the date. Move money off the float. Make the null explicit instead of silently dropping the row. Read it like a diff, not like an answer.

props.title: transform.py
props.code:
# transform.py - generated by Claude, then reviewed line by line
from decimal import Decimal
import pandas as pd

def transform(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # created_at: source ships ISO strings, target wants timestamptz
    df["created_at"] = pd.to_datetime(df["created_at"], utc=True)

    # amount: float -> Decimal. money never rides a float
    df["amount"] = df["amount"].map(lambda v: Decimal(str(v)))

    # customer_id: nullable upstream, NOT NULL downstream.
    # do not drop the row - quarantine it, keep the count honest
    df["_quarantine"] = df["customer_id"].isna()
    return df

beats.role_note: the Teardown split - what it is good at versus what it cannot own
beats.narration_text: It is genuinely good at mapping schemas, boilerplate, tests, and two a.m. stack traces. It cannot tell you what the number means, what the business promised, or what downstream was guaranteed. It writes the pipeline; it does not own it.

beats.role_note: the failure mode the speed creates - volume green, values wrong
beats.narration_text: The pipeline runs clean — green check, row counts match, nobody gets paged — while a bad cast quietly rounds every amount the wrong way. A pipeline that runs is not one that is right.
beats.visual_intent: Rows stream through the pipe, the row counter races to its target and locks green. Underneath, a second track quietly diverges in terracotta and never alarms.

beats.role_note: verdict recap as the Claude artifact page
beats.narration_text: So, the verdict. AI collapses the glue, not the judgment. It flags the mismatches; it never resolves them. It makes code review the most valuable skill on the team — writing just got free, reading did not.

props.artifactTitle: Verdict · AI in the ETL loop
props.artifactHeading: It collapses the glue, not the judgment
artifactLines: The boring 90% — mapping, boilerplate, tests, docs — stops being handwritten.
It flags every mismatch it can see. It never decides what to do about one.
Row count is not correctness: assert on values, not on volume.
Writing code got free. Reading it did not — review is the bottleneck now.
